Indirect/inferential (article is about the field, not this pipeline by name), hence low tier, single source, not independent.

Two independent trade-press sources agree the Abu Sennan field is a real, active oil (and gas) field in Egypt's Western Desert: Egypt Oil & Gas news (9 May 2017) reports BORAPETCO drilling in its 'Abu Sinan area' concession with existing production of 3,860 b/d of crude; Egypt Oil & Gas's 'The Western Desert' research report (March 2020) profiles '3) THE ABU SENNAN' field ('10 km South East Neag area... discovered by Kuwait Energy... Rockhopper... currently producing 5,100 boe/d') and separately lists an 'Abu Sennan Spur' gas connector in its infrastructure table. PDF content-substring screen fails on extraction (see P3693 note); hand-confirmed by direct read, ok/contains_value recorded true accordingly.

Same two independent sources as FuelSource confirm Abu Sennan is located in Egypt's Western Desert ('10 km South East Neag area' per the 2020 report; BORAPETCO's 'Abu Sinan area' concession per the 2017 article), supporting StartLocation = 'Abu Sennan area, Western Desert' / StartCountryOrArea = Egypt. Neither source names Abu Sennan's specific district/governorate, so this supports the primary_value and Western Desert/Egypt fields only.

El Hamra terminal itself is independently well-documented (WEPCO's own site; Egypt Oil & Gas's 2020 report -- both used on P3693), but neither states El Hamra sits in Matruh governorate, and the two Arabic articles specific to this pipeline (which would confirm the endpoint tie for this exact line) are unreachable (see Status notes). Left unresolved rather than citing a source that doesn't cover the full stated value (StartState/Province + endpoint attribution) per the no-orphan-ref rule.

The almalnews.com headline itself ('800 million EGP investment') suggests a different EGP cost figure than the sheet's $56,000,000 USD, but the article body is a confirmed 404 with no Wayback capture, so this cannot be read to confirm or refute the value -- flagging as a possible sheet/source discrepancy for Update to check if that article is ever recovered, rather than citing an unread headline. Left UNRESOLVED per the no-orphan/don't-cite-disagreements rule.

Egypt Oil & Gas's 2020 Western Desert report shows 'General Petroleum Company (GPC)' (= الشركة العامة للبترول) active in the Abu Sennan area, operating a gas/condensate processing plant there -- circumstantially consistent with GPC being the sheet's named operator, but it documents a gas plant, not this oil pipeline, so it is not being cited as an orphan/indirect ref for Operator. The two project-specific Arabic articles that would confirm GPC as this line's operator directly are unreachable (see Status notes).
